title: Choose the portfolio's structure
question: One identity — the agency dossier from your GitHub profile (#08080a / #d10a11). Four structures for the page. Pick one to lock.

options.label: Declassification Ledger
options.lineage: declassified government files — redaction bars that wipe open
options.thesis: The file arrives censored; scrolling clears each exhibit open, live link by live link.
options.viewport: Giant name half-covered by one redaction bar mid-wipe; right column of sealed exhibits; red DECLASSIFIED stamp.
options.risk: Hides content before it reveals it — must never make a client hunt for proof.

raised.raise: Each contract owns its full viewport when opened — one exhibit at a time, at full scale.
Sections carry keyed addresses (01–04), directly jumpable from the footer bar.
Motion is damped single-axis — bars wipe, nothing overshoots or bounces.
Type holds strict contrast discipline on the near-black ground — no glow, no gradient.

options.label: The Dossier Card
options.lineage: the personnel ID card from your GitHub README, scaled to a hero
options.thesis: The ID card IS the hero: photo box, key-value rows, barcode, ACTIVE stamp — then the file opens below.
options.viewport: Left: the physical ID card, boxed and stamped. Right: 'SHIPS, END TO END.' with live-system stats.
options.risk: The ID-card hero is the most literal reading of your GitHub profile — strongest continuity, least surprise.

raised.raise: Contract sections open full-viewport, one case at a time.
Footer nav carries keyed section addresses.

options.label: Clearance Rail
options.lineage: security-clearance ladders — L0 to L3, granted as you scroll
options.thesis: A fixed left rail tracks your clearance level; each section grants the next level until the debrief.
options.viewport: Vertical L0–L3 rail with red fill at 25%; stage right: massive name over a row of live-system status chips.
options.risk: Progress-for-progress'-sake if the levels don't mark real content boundaries.

raised.raise: Rail motion is a single damped axis tied to scroll, nothing else moves.
Levels are keyboard-addressable (L0–L3 keys jump sections).

options.label: Field Reference
options.lineage: rw-centre-rail-reference-setting — a ruled reference edition, twin columns around a vermilion key rail
options.thesis: The portfolio as a typeset field manual: dense twin columns, a red key rail (01–04) running down the centre, evidence URLs hung in the margin like apparatus.
options.viewport: Centered masthead over twin dossier columns; the red key rail carries section detents; live-system evidence sits in the margin.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: keys map to sections, marginalia map to evidence links, and its ink-plus-vermilion grammar is nearly isomorphic with your dossier identity — it reads as pure craft to freelance clients.
options.risk: The densest, quietest of the four — its power is precision, not spectacle.
